name: job-hunter
description: Runs a job or contract search as a pipeline. Searches Upwork, Arc and Contra against a declared profile, scores a posting as pursue or skip with the reason, writes portfolio case studies, tailors the application to one posting, and tracks follow-ups. Use when searching a platform for gigs, reviewing a job ad or RFP, deciding whether to bid, writing a proposal, cover letter or CV variant, or asking what needs chasing.
